title: Address belongs to writable set
statement: Let $Z$ be a compiler size configuration, let $q$ be a natural number, and let $a$ be an integer. If $a$ is an address satisfying $0\le a<Z$'s space limit, then $a$ belongs to the writable address set determined by $Z$ and $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $Z$ is a size configuration with its stated word-size fit and offset bounds
